notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Section, Pub. L. 98–481, § 2, Oct. 17, 1984, 98 Stat. 2250, which set out definitions, was omitted from the Code as being of special and not general application.

notes.heading: Short Title
notes.text: Pub. L. 98–481, § 1, Oct. 17, 1984, 98 Stat. 2250, provided that Pub. L. 98–481, enacting this subchapter, could be cited as the “Coos, Lower Umpqua, and Siuslaw Restoration Act”.

ancestors.heading: CONFEDERATED TRIBES OF COOS, LOWER UMPQUA, AND SIUSLAW INDIANS: RESTORATION OF FEDERAL SUPERVISION
